package typescript

import (
    "encoding/json"
    "os"
    "sync"
    "github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/shim/ast"
    "github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/shim/core"
    "github.com/system-inc/cohere/internal/types/sourcename"
)

var adamicCaptureLock sync.Mutex
func adamicRecord(value any) {
    path := os.Getenv("ADAMIC_TYPESCRIPT_HELPER_CAPTURE")
    if path == "" { panic("missing capture path") }
    data, err := json.Marshal(value)
    if err != nil { panic(err) }
    adamicCaptureLock.Lock()
    defer adamicCaptureLock.Unlock()
    file, err := os.OpenFile(path, os.O_APPEND|os.O_CREATE|os.O_WRONLY, 0600)
    if err != nil { panic(err) }
    defer file.Close()
    if _, err = file.Write(append(data, '\n')); err != nil { panic(err) }
}
func isTypeScriptSourceFile(name string) bool {
    result := adamicOriginalIsTypeScriptSourceFile(name)
    adamicRecord(map[string]any{"kind":"file", "name":name, "want":result})
    adamicRecord(map[string]any{"kind":"name", "name":name, "want":sourcename.TreatedAs(name)})
    return result
}
func nonNullAssertionOperatorRange(node *ast.Node) core.TextRange {
    result := adamicOriginalNonNullAssertionOperatorRange(node)
    adamicRecord(map[string]any{"kind":"range", "end":node.End(), "wantStart":result.Pos(), "wantEnd":result.End()})
    return result
}
